name: 柔和手绘
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original terrain material atlas for a 2D top-down chibi tactical defense game. Primary request: ONE extremely wide horizontal strip with EXACTLY FIVE equal SQUARE panels, flush together, no padding, gutters, dividers, text, labels or frames. Left to right: 1 short grass ground, 2 compacted earth/dirt, 3 fine gravel, 4 plain poured concrete, 5 dark matte steel surface. Each panel is a flat straight-down material texture, edge-to-edge fill, uniform neutral overhead lighting, designed to repeat without visible seams. All five materials share a restrained game palette and illustration style. No perspective, no objects/characters/buildings/shadows/terrain height/landscape/horizon, no paths baked into grass, no isolated tufts casting shadows, no giant stones or distinctive focal crack. Concrete and steel have no tile borders or grout lines; those will be assembled by the engine. Opaque background. Sharp clean high-resolution 2D art, NOT pixel art. Do not merge/blend neighboring material panels. Style A: soft detailed hand-painted strategy game ground. Natural muted sage/olive grass, warm taupe earth, gentle warm-gray gravel, light warm-gray concrete, desaturated green-gray steel. Delicate short brush marks, soft color transitions, modest small-scale grain, extremely low contrast within each material. Ground should be calm behind finely outlined anime chibi characters. No glossy shine, no photorealism, no heavy vignette.
